svg.text: once per scan, before any run, then frozen
Several independent skull-strippers mask the scan:
named in the gated reference pack
each reference tool, scored with itself left out
fixed rules, no human or LLM judge: same mask, same score
Dice is recorded but carries no weight here.
Points add up to the quality score; the total sets the grade:
within reference variability: every metric inside the panel's range
a mask can score well overall and still be wrong
Example: an intensity stripper, tight threshold
core it left out, in one piece
Its metrics alone would add up to about 71,
But one contiguous 27.5 cm³ frontal cut
no focal core cut fails → invalid, quality 0
all gates pass, within reference variability
Example: structural-brain-extraction task, healthy adult T1w (OpenNeuro ds002790). Each task has its own reference tools, gates and weights; the three steps are the same.
